name: Larry Vales: Traffic Division
summary:
Larry Vales is a traffic patrol officer in the small town of Stagnant, Tennessee. Parking enforcement has taken an alarming turn following the introduction of the Lovely Rita 4200, a parking enforcement cyborg developed by the eccentric Professor Semprini. Unfortunately, the machine has gone berserk and begun sentencing motorists to death for even the most minor traffic violations.

Larry and his considerably less enthusiastic partner, Charlie Striker, are dispatched to the Jolly Parasite Motor Estates, where the cyborg was last sighted. Their assignment is to find and disable the machine before its interpretation of traffic law gets any worse.
